attempts.feedback:
Proven correct. Cost: 1.10 cycles per call, clang: 1.48.
Can you make it even faster? If you believe this version is optimal, answer NO_IMPROVEMENT and one sentence why.

attempts.response: NO_IMPROVEMENT 2 dependent integer ops (AND to isolate bit1 plus LEA/IMUL by 9 to duplicate to bits 1 and 4) is the minimal dataflow for this bit-duplication; no single x86 ALU op can produce two disjoint output bits from one input bit and any other 2-op sequence has equal or higher latency/throughput on Skylake.
